info.description: Every operation except this document needs a personal API token, created on the API tokens page or with createToken, or by an administrator for another user with createUserToken. door_ids.description: The ids of the doors, ascending, that are not deleted whose timeline or access depends on what the query names.

code.description: The door code: 6 to 20 digits that no other user has.

secret.description: The token to send. This is the only time it is shown; it cannot be recovered.

rule_ids.description: The access rules naming one of the user's groups that reach the door.

works.description: When the user's code opens the door during the days asked for: while a rule's schedule is active and the door is not locked.

doors.description: This page of doors, by name.

per_page.description: How many doors a page holds.

total.description: How many doors the query selects, on every page together.

location.description: Where the door is, up to 200 characters.

name.description: The door's name, up to 100 characters; unique, ignoring case.

notes.description: What administrators should know about the door, up to 2000 characters.

open_schedule_ids.description: The ids of the schedules during which the door is in open mode. Omit it for a door that is never in open mode.

public.description: True to show the door in the user portal.

zone_ids.description: The ids of the zones the door is in.

deleted_at.description: When the door was deleted; absent unless it is deleted.

id.description: Names the door in the API.

location.description: Where the door is; may be empty.

notes.description: What administrators should know about the door; may be empty.

open_schedules.description: The schedules during which the door is in open mode and unlocks on any keypress, by name.

primary_picture_id.description: The picture lists and the user portal show; absent when the door has no pictures.

public.description: True when the user portal shows the door.

zones.description: The zones the door is in, by name.

entrants.description: Each access rule that reaches the door, oldest first.

direct.description: True when the rule names the door itself.

group.description: The group whose members may enter.

rule_id.description: The access rule that lets them in.

schedule.description: The schedule during which they may enter.

zones.description: The zones the door is in through which the rule reaches it, by name.

request_id.description: Names the failure in the server log; present only when the server failed.

description.description: What the group is for, up to 1000 characters.

name.description: The group's name, up to 100 characters.

preassigned_user_ids.description: User ids whose users join the group when they are created.

roles.description: The roles the group carries: admin, manage-users, manage-doors, manage-groups, manage-schedules, manage-firmware, view-logs, door-commander. The caller must hold each.

slug.description: Up to 64 lowercase letters and digits, in words joined by single dashes; unique.

description.description: What the group is for; may be empty.

id.description: Names the group in the API.

preassigned_user_ids.description: User ids whose users join the group when they are created.

roles.description: The roles the group carries; every member holds them.

slug.description: The group's unique, URL-safe name; identity providers' entitlements match it.

members.description: The group's members, by display name.

occurrences.description: When the schedule is active during those days, in order. Overlapping or touching windows are joined, and an occurrence that runs past the range is cut at it.

time_zone.description: The site timezone the schedule's windows are read in.

start.description: When the schedule becomes active, with the site timezone's offset.

overrides.description: The overrides in force and those to come, by start.

end.description: When it ends: after the start, and in the future.

reason.description: Why it is made, up to 500 characters.

start.description: When it starts. A start in the past starts it now.

active.description: True while it is in force: it has started and not ended.

created_by.description: The user who made it, by id and display name.

id.description: Names the override in the API.

kind.description: open forces the door open, so any keypress unlocks it; locked keeps it locked against every code but a door commander's.

reason.description: Why it was made; may be empty.

picture.description: The image: JPEG, PNG, GIF, or WebP.

id.description: Names the picture in the API.

image_url.description: Where the image is served, as JPEG.

primary.description: True for the door's primary picture, which lists and the user portal show.

thumbnail_url.description: Where a thumbnail of the image is served, as JPEG.

door_ids.description: The ids of the doors it names.

group_id.description: The id of the group whose members the rule lets in.

schedule_id.description: The id of the schedule during which it lets them in; the Always schedule has id 1.

zone_ids.description: The ids of the zones it names. A rule names at least one door or zone.

doors.description: The doors it names, by name.

group.description: The group whose members the rule lets in.

id.description: Names the access rule in the API.

schedule.description: The schedule during which it lets them in.

zones.description: The zones it names, by name; it reaches every door in them.

ends_on.description: The last day, YYYY-MM-DD, on which windows open. Omit it for a schedule that never ends.

excluded_dates.description: Up to 366 dates, YYYY-MM-DD, on which no window opens.

name.description: The schedule's name, up to 100 characters; unique, ignoring case.

starts_on.description: The first day, YYYY-MM-DD, on which windows open. Omit it for a schedule that has always been in effect.

builtin.description: True for the seeded Always schedule, which cannot be changed or deleted.

ends_on.description: The last day, YYYY-MM-DD, on which windows open; absent when the schedule never ends.

excluded_dates.description: The dates, YYYY-MM-DD, on which no window opens, in order.

id.description: Names the schedule in the API.

starts_on.description: The first day, YYYY-MM-DD, on which windows open; absent when the schedule has always been in effect.

windows.description: The weekly windows, in the order they were given.

env_var.description: The environment variable that overrides the setting.

read_only.description: True when the environment provides the value, which then cannot be changed here.

source.description: Where the value comes from: environment, database, or default.

updated_at.description: When an administrator last stored a value; absent when none is stored.

start.description: When the span starts, with the site timezone's offset.

state.description: open: the door is in open mode, from a schedule or an open override, and any keypress unlocks it. locked: a locked override keeps it locked.

spans.description: When the door is open or locked during those days, in order; between spans it is in its normal state, where a code opens it. Locked overrides win over open overrides, which win over open-mode schedules.

time_zone.description: The site timezone schedules are read in.

expires_in_days.description: Days until the token expires, from 1 to 3650. Omit it for a token that never expires.

name.description: What the token is for, up to 100 characters.

expired.description: True once the token has expired.

expires_at.description: When the token stops working; absent when it never expires.

id.description: Names the token, to revoke it.

doors.description: Each door that is not deleted which an access rule naming one of the user's groups reaches, by name.

time_zone.description: The site timezone schedules are read in.

per_page.description: How many users a page holds.

total.description: How many users the search selects, on every page together.

users.description: This page of users, by display name.

display_name.description: The name pages show, up to 100 characters. Omit it to use the first and last names.

email.description: The user's email address; stored lowercase and unique.

expires_at.description: When the account stops working. Omit it for an account that never expires.

first_name.description: The user's first name, up to 100 characters.

last_name.description: The user's last name, up to 100 characters.

user_id.description: The user's external id, up to 64 letters, digits, dots, dashes, or underscores; unique. Omit it for a user without one.

deleted_at.description: When the user was deleted; absent unless they are deleted.

display_name.description: The name pages show for the user.

expired.description: True once the account has expired.

expires_at.description: When the account stops working; absent when it never expires.

first_name.description: The user's first name; may be empty.

groups.description: The groups the user is a member of, by name. The user holds every role these groups carry.

has_code.description: True when the user has a door code. The code itself is never shown.

id.description: Names the user in the API.

last_name.description: The user's last name; may be empty.

user_id.description: The user's external id, such as an employee or student number; absent when they have none.

days.description: The weekdays the window opens on: mon, tue, wed, thu, fri, sat, sun.

end.description: When the window closes, as HH:MM in the site timezone. An end at or before the start is on the next day, so 00:00 to 00:00 is all day.

start.description: When the window opens, as HH:MM in the site timezone.

description.description: What the zone is, up to 500 characters.

door_ids.description: The ids of the doors in the zone.

name.description: The zone's name, up to 100 characters; unique, ignoring case.

description.description: What the zone is; may be empty.

doors.description: The doors in the zone, by name, deleted ones included.

id.description: Names the zone in the API.

basicAuth.description: A personal API token as the HTTP Basic password. The user name is ignored.

bearerAuth.description: A personal API token in the Authorization header: `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.
